english.title: Drive / operate vehicle other than place provided without authorisation - Liverpool Airport
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), on part of Liverpool John Lennon Airport to which the road traffic enactments did not apply, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), drove or operated a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), other than in a place provided for the passage or accommodation of such a vehicle, without the permission of Liverpool Airport limited
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2(1)(c) and 6(1) of the Liverpool John Lennon Airport Byelaws 2022.
